_comment: Products confirmed by looking at the Intermarché app or site, rather than by a receipt. Hand-edited, like preferences.json. This exists because their catalogue cannot be read from here (403, DataDome), so the only way a product Charlotte has never bought becomes exact is if she shows it to us. Anything in here joins the pricebook with its real name and price and stops being a guess. Record what was actually on screen and nothing more — no inferred sizes, no remembered prices.
